sources.excerpt: Fuzzrocious Pedals Announces Cicada Fuzz V5 Pedal – No Treble Skip to main content No Treble Gear Basses Amps Pedals & Effects Accessories & Strings Pickups Bass of the Week Gear Reviews News New Albums Sheet Music & Instruction Concerts & Tours Events Columns From the Bottom Bass Players To Know Ask Damian Erskine Recording Bass The Lightbulb Moment The Lowdown with Dr. D Health & Fitness Lessons Keep It Groovy Bass Gym Talking Technique Bass Transcriptions The Brown’stone Creative Bass Lines Bass & Creativity Bass Lick Series Advanced Bass Talking Style Bassists Interviews Wonder Women Stories Behind the Songs Reader Spotlight In Memoriam Share Your Story Videos Podcast Bass Nerds Podcast Groove Podcast Shop Subscribe Archives On This Day in Bass Contributors Contact Home Bass Gear Pedals & Effects Fuzzrocious Pedals Announces Cicada Fuzz V5 Pedal by Kevin Johnson Monday, August 19th, 2019 Share Tweet Email Comments Fuzzrocious Pedals has unveiled the fifth iteration of their Cicada Fuzz, which is produced in limited numbers each year. Version five of the tremolo-fuzz pedal is limited to 17 units in homage to the 17 Year Periodical Cicada. It has two speed pots that can be selected with a footswitch, while a Tymbal control adjusts a filter on the circuit to replicate the sound of a cicada. Other features include a gate, an oscillation (feeback) switch, and a Voice switch to toggle the fuzz between germanium diodes, no diodes, and 1n914 diodes. Check out the pedal’s sound on guitar and bass: The Fuzzrocious Cicada Fuzz V5 is available for order for $300. Fuzzrocious Pedals Cicada Fuzz V5 Pedal Features: Voice Switch: Germanium, None, 1N914 Diodes Dual Speed Controls with Momentary Speed Selector Switch Oscillation Footswitch Gate Knob Powdercoated and Screenprinted by JuxtaPrints Limited to 17 Units Built in USA In his time with No Treble, Kevin has met hundreds of amazing bassists and interviewed icons like Jack Casady, Victor Wooten, Les Claypool, Marcus Miller, and more. He's a gigging bassist performing jazz in Northern Virginia and bluegrass with The Plate Scrapers up and down the East Coast. Kevin appreciates all genres of music, from R&B to metal and everything in between. Connect with Kevin on Facebook and check his performance schedule on his website .
